attributes.board_name: Kentucky Board of Licensed Professional Counselors

rules.accepted_credit_types: Without board review: programs sponsored/approved by ACA, Kentucky Counseling Association, NBCC or a state counseling licensure board; CACREP-program academic courses (1 credit = 15 h). Other programs need board approval
rules.audit_note: Licensees list CE at renewal; up to 15% randomly selected to document; keep proof 1 year from renewal.

topics.who: Within the first 3 years of initial licensure and every 6 years thereafter (KRS 210.366)
Kentucky counseling law KRS 335.500-335.599 and 201 KAR Chapter 36, every 3 years

rules.notes: Annual renewal by October 31 (201 KAR 36:075). Mandatory DV, suicide and law courses must be board-approved. Supervision training for supervisors under 201 KAR 36:065 is separate.
